name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
verdict: Gold-standard open-source roguelike; desktop jar (52MB) and Android debug APK (35.1MB) built clean first try, desktop boots and renders under Xvfb, mobile is a first-class target with full android/+ios/ modules and touch-first input.

name: Unciv
verdict: Reference open-source 4X: desktop jar (56MB) and Android debug APK (32MB, minSdk21, 4 ABIs) build clean first try on JDK21; game renders under Xvfb, headless multiplayer server boots, and the APK actually runs on an Android emulator (logcat: LanguagePickerScreen, focused window) with 135 unit tests passing; full Civ V parity content, touch gestures + autosave; only gap is no iOS target.

name: Mindustry
verdict: Gold standard of open-source games: deep, commercially shipped factory-RTS that builds clean on JDK21 in minutes (desktop fat jar 88.5MB, server 19.3MB) and boots a live headless world server (map loaded, hosted on 6567, 61 FPS tick), with first-class android/ (minSdk21/targetSdk36) and RoboVM ios/ targets plus dedicated MobileInput touch layer.

name: OpenHV
verdict: Deep, actively developed Dune-like RTS on the C#/.NET OpenRA engine (not libGDX: no settings.gradle/gradlew/android/ exist). Builds clean (make engine + dotnet OpenHV.slnx, 0 errors) and runs verified: GUI client renders under Xvfb (OpenGL 4.6 core via llvmpipe, 98% non-black animating screenshots), headless dedicated server reaches master-server lobby and accepts TCP on 1234, utility.sh --check-yaml validates all rules + 69 maps. GPL-3.0, 1087 stars, commits 3 days old, 3 campaigns. Mobile score is a hard zero: no Android/iOS project anywhere, no touch input — the official-Android-client premise in the brief is false.

name: SuperTuxKart
verdict: Flagship open-source kart racer: clean CMake+Ninja -j8 Release build (819/819 targets, 0 errors, 20MB binary) on CachyOS with all native deps already present; headless engine boot verified (--version, --no-render --list-tracks scan data/shaders then exit with a clean documented media-missing abort); official Play Store Android port with first-class touch stack (multitouch device, touch race HUD, button-layout editor, accelerometer steering) and full android/ Gradle project; ~5.4k stars, commits days old, 4 CI workflows; caveat: game ASSETS are a separate unfetchable repo (code-repo game-data/stk-assets URLs 404, gitlab 403) so full gameplay needs out-of-band assets.

name: Thrive
verdict: Ambitious AAA-grade open-source evolution sim that builds 0-error, boots headless to 'Thrive Startup Succeeded' with zero errors and 120/120 unit tests, but is strictly desktop-only (no mobile presets or touch input) and needs LFS materialization plus an official mono Godot editor.

name: wesnoth
title: Battle for Wesnoth
verdict: Flagship open-source game: 21 campaigns, 656 units, 60 langs, official Android port, clean build + verified headless boot — S-tier anchor.

name: luanti
verdict: Definitive open-source voxel sandbox: clean from-scratch build, headless server verified on UDP 30001, official Android app in-repo, deepest mod ecosystem in free software.
